title: Negative values unsupported in range slider
body:
**Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?**
Bug. Example: https://jsfiddle.net/8zzvL5y1/

**Bug: What is the current behavior?**

Attributes with negative values do not show those negative values in the range slider. Additionally, explicitly setting a negative minimum doesn't seem to fix anything.

**Bug: What is the expected behavior?**

I'd expect any positive or negative numbers to be supported.

**Bug: What browsers are impacted? Which versions?**

Chrome (Mac) 61.0.3163.100

**Bug: What is the proposed solution?**

- support negative values in facets
- set range selection minimum appropriately

**What is the version you are using? Always use the latest one before opening a bug issue.**
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/instantsearch.js@1/dist/instantsearch.min.css

comments.body: That's for the maintenance version. AFAIK, this is a limitation of the previous implementation of the slider, and we changed it in v2. I'm not sure we're gonna be able to make something for this v1. Can you update?
We will not add new features to maintenance releases, as said :)
